queries.sql:
SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.client_name, projects.location, projects.description, projects.created_at, projects.updated_at 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = $1::UUID

SELECT plants.id, plants.taxon_id, plants.scientific_name, plants.common_name, plants.category, plants.planting_place, plants.description, plants.common_diseases, plants.care_data, plants.icon_url, plants.image_url, plants.created_at 
FROM plants 
WHERE plants.id = $1::UUID

SELECT projectplants.project_id, projectplants.plant_id, projectplants.notes, projectplants.quantity, projectplants.unit, projectplants.optimum_height_size, projectplants.rate 
FROM projectplants 
WHERE projectplants.project_id = $1::UUID AND projectplants.plant_id = $2::UUID
UPDATE projects SET updated_at=$1::TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE WHERE projects.id = $2::UUID
INSERT INTO projectplants (project_id, plant_id, notes, quantity, unit, optimum_height_size, rate) VALUES ($1::UUID, $2::UUID, $3::VARCHAR, $4::FLOAT, $5::VARCHAR, $6::VARCHAR, $7::FLOAT)
